'''Ordnance''' was a division of the [[Support Service Branch]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. It was responsible for the installation and maintenance of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Navy's various armaments.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Imperial Sourcebook|first edition]] of the ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'', published in [[1989]], Ordnance was listed as being the division of the Support Service Branch tasked with using armament. The [[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|second edition]], released in [[1994]], amended the entry; Ordnance was responsible for the installation and maintenance of the weapons, with operation of the weapons falling to the newly created [[Gunnery]] division.
